title: Incorporating a church to avoid the Vietnam draft

tellings.quote: And we incorporated the Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America incorporated

plain: Peter Levenda, an author and researcher described as a historian of the CIA, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about his youth in the Bronx, New York, around 1968. He says he and others legally set up a church, which he names as the Ottophilis Savonic Orthodox Church of North and South America, as a way to avoid the draft, the compulsory call-up of young men to fight in the Vietnam War. He tells it as part of his own unusual path into the world of hidden religion and secret history.
